s01_hook
Dot and Key sells in ten categories, on its own store and three marketplaces. Market Studio turns that market data into a finished, checked campaign.
s02_overview
It crawls the catalogue, Amazon, Flipkart and Nykaa, and scores every category. Lip balm leads, with demand forecast up twenty-two percent. Let's take sunscreen.
s03_competitors
It finds the top five competitors with prices and ratings, compares them aspect by aspect, and tracks their new launches.
s04_customers
Sentiment across nearly a thousand reviews shows what buyers care about: greasiness, texture and white cast, each linked to the reviews behind it.
s05_ask
Or just ask. Who scores higher at a lower price? The answer is built from evidence, not a chatbot, so every line cites its source.
s06_strategy
Strategy builds the SWOT, spots gaps, like no SPF fifty mist under five hundred rupees, and recommends next moves. One click turns any insight into a campaign brief.
s07_research
Here's a finished Watermelon Sunscreen campaign. The studio finds reels that beat their usual views, this one a hundred and sixty-eight times over, and breaks down the hook and timing.
s08_script
That winning pattern becomes a concept, then a shot-by-shot script and storyboard, with every line traced back to catalogue wording.
s09_ads
Then static ads for Meta, Google and every marketplace, A-plus content, listings, and a Hindi translation, generated live.
s10_video
And a hero film with an AI voiceover, checked automatically against the brief.
s11_kit
A claim guard blocks anything the catalogue doesn't say. Then it plans the A B tests, and packages the kit.
s12_close
Market Studio. From market intelligence to marketing content, in one app.
